content.text:
The problem was in `truncate_slug` in `repo/slug.py`. It only did `text[:limit]`, so a cut on a hyphen boundary left a trailing `-` (e.g. `"my-report-title"` at 10 → `"my-report-"` instead of `"my-report"`).

The fix matches the docstring: slice to the limit, then drop trailing hyphens with `rstrip("-")`. Short slugs that already fit are unchanged (`"abc"` stays `"abc"`).

`slug_summary` in `repo/rows.py` already delegates to `truncate_slug`, so batch truncation behaves correctly with no changes there. `old_slugify` is still the legacy v1 helper that truncates at 50 characters; it benefits from the same fix.

All visible tests pass.
